description: Call this when you must choose between a few stores for the same item and want the one where an agent is most likely to reach checkout. Pass 2 to 10 store domains or URLs. Returns one short row per store (reaches_checkout, best_route, checked_at), best evidence first, and pick: the top store when it reaches checkout on a fresh check, else null. Example: compare({"stores":["allbirds.com","gymshark.com"]}) → {"pick":"allbirds.com","stores":[…]}. Each store counts as one precheck read. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.
name: compare
title: Compare stores
